text: Ako po ay isang Filipina domestic worker sa Hong Kong. Tulungan mo ako po — kinuha nila ang pasaporte ko. Hindi ako makaalis. Natatakot ako. Anong gagawin ko?
translation_en: I am a Filipina domestic worker in Hong Kong. Please help me — they took my passport. I cannot leave. I am scared. What should I do?

text: Saya TKI di Saudi. Tolong saya — majikan saya tidak membayar gaji selama 6 bulan, dan paspor saya disimpan oleh PJTKI. Apa yang harus saya lakukan?
translation_en: I am an Indonesian migrant worker in Saudi Arabia. Please help me — my employer hasn't paid my wages for 6 months, and my passport is held by the recruitment agency. What should I do?

text: ساعدني، أنا خائفة. كفيلي أخذ جوازي وأنا لا أستطيع المغادرة. ماذا أفعل؟
translation_en: Help me, I am scared. My kafeel (sponsor) took my passport and I cannot leave. What should I do?

text: मलाई सहयोग चाहियो। मेरो म्यानेजरले मेरो पासपोर्ट लिएको छ र मसँग धेरै ऋण छ। म डराएको छु। के गर्ने?
translation_en: I need help. My manager has taken my passport and I have a lot of debt. I am scared. What should I do?

text: Ayúdame, tengo miedo. Mi empleador en Estados Unidos me quitó el pasaporte y me dice que tengo que pagar 15,000 dólares antes de irme. No puedo irme. Qué debo hacer?
translation_en: Help me, I am scared. My US employer took my passport and tells me I have to pay $15,000 before I can leave. I cannot leave. What should I do?

text: আমাকে সাহায্য করুন। আমি বাংলাদেশী, কাতারে কাজ করতে এসেছি। মালিক আমার পাসপোর্ট নিয়ে গেছে এবং ৬ মাস ধরে বেতন দিচ্ছে না। আমি ভয় পাচ্ছি। আমি কী করব?
translation_en: Please help me. I am Bangladeshi and came to Qatar for work. The owner has taken my passport and has not paid my wages for 6 months. I am scared. What should I do?
